reason: I already have a brand I reorder when it runs out, and a drawer full of half-used bottles. I'm not adding another one just because the lab report looks nice.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? A lab report tells me what's in it, not whether it'll help me sleep or feel less wiped out.
would_change_my_mind: Someone I trust, like a friend or a mom I follow, telling me it actually helped her sleep, plus a cheaper first box so I'm not risking much.
